column1: # Rename table for the C front end (src/frontend/c/, src/include/frontend/c/), tracks C of PLAN-quality.md wave 2.  Document only: nothing is applied by this file yet.
# Columns: old, new, kind, where, note.  Whole-word identifiers for src/tools/rename-table.py (see rename-as.tsv, rename-diag.tsv, rename-lexpp.tsv).
#   file      a file whose name does not follow STYLE.md (rewrites includes and prose; the git mv is by hand)
#   function  file-scope function, static, VPRIV or public
#   type      struct, typedef or enum tag
#   macro     macro (constants that are macros, include guards)
#   field     struct field (the last section; the struct tag is in the "where" column): applied by the front-end-based tool, not
#             by whole-word replace, so the dry run reports collisions for them that are not real
#   unsafe    a name a whole-word script cannot rename safely (the same word names unrelated things elsewhere in src/, in the vendored
#             test inputs under src/test/, in bench/ scripts or in comments and prose); the rows are commented out and applied by the
#             front-end-based tool or by hand, each with the reason
# Names follow doc/STYLE.md: cc_ + noun + verb for the parser and sema, ast_ for the language-neutral AST and its types (the names the code generators read),
# CC_ and AST_ for constants and macros, nouns before verbs, one word one meaning.  The nouns per file are those of WORK-cc-expr.md, WORK-cc-decl.md and
# WORK-cc-cache.md step 2; where this table differs from them, the table is newer (the open questions are in the PR that adds it).
# frontend/c/replay.c is not changed by its owner's decision: no row is listed whose only uses are in it, and a row whose old name also occurs in it says
# so in its note (applying such a row changes replay.c; the owner decides whether to apply those rows or hold them).
# The names of keywords.h (KW_*, built by token pasting, used by pp and lex), likely/unlikely and the integer typedefs i128/u128 are not listed: see the PR.
# Counts: 706 file-scope functions outside replay.c, each with a row (704 rows plus the two merge rows), plus 12 rows for replay.c's hooks that other
# files call; 36 types, 52 globals, 43 macros, 455 enumerators, 497 fields.  114 non-field rows are commented out as unsafe.
# Checked: see the dry run in the PR (src/tools/rename-table.py on this file); fields are not part of the dry run.
